obligations.subject: information receiver
obligations.condition: declared integrity option selected and supported
obligations.requiredObservation: option identity, receiver support and protected bytes

obligations.subject: upload receiver
obligations.condition: declared integrity option selected and supported
obligations.requiredObservation: option identity, receiver support and protected bytes

obligations.subject: final load image and LSP
obligations.condition: all load bytes and declared check-value fields are present
obligations.requiredObservation: algorithm identity, ordered image bytes and LSP check value

obligations.subject: old and new target files
obligations.condition: optional comparison is selected and both file identities are evidenced
obligations.requiredObservation: old/new file identities, bytes and comparison result

obligations.subject: two files with the same part number
obligations.condition: two distinct file identities declare the same part number
obligations.requiredObservation: both file identities, their common part number, CRC A, CRC B, and CRC-A-equals-CRC-B relation

obligations.subject: status-file stream after final DATA
obligations.condition: integrity calculation remains in progress after final DATA
obligations.requiredObservation: final-DATA event, calculation interval and continued status-file events
